cause_quote: The new `if (!channelType)` branch called `logVerbose(...)` and then executed `return;` before the existing `slackInboundLog.info(...)` call.
user_saw: An operator saw no INFO log explaining why a Slack mention was skipped when the channel lookup failed on a cold cache.
summary: The Slack monitor now logs a redacted INFO diagnostic with a categorized lookup failure when it skips a mention whose channel type it cannot resolve.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: previously, a failed lookup on a cold cache returned empty metadata, and a typeless C-prefixed mention still reached the INFO receipt through channel-prefix inference. The new unresolved-type branch bypassed that receipt and left only a verbose log. The fix restores INFO-level visibility while preserving the intentional skip.
